mentions.description: A personal Firefox fork maintained by HN user ramijames. It removes unwanted features (Firefox sync, VPN), reworks Mozilla's UX/UI choices, and adds integrations the author wants: integrated mail and calendar, a Notion-like document library system, native ad-blocking, a terminal, Trello-like task tracking, and Harvest-like time tracking. It also integrates AI (Apple Intelligence on macOS for simple tasks and Claude for harder ones). The fork replaces half a dozen open applications and enables workflows such as scheduled web searches delivered as a custom daily email brief, a queryable memory of work across clients, aggregated analytics from multiple web dashboards, a node-based infinite canvas with live websites in the workflow, and automatic task updates triggered by actions like sending a client email.
mentions.problem: The author was juggling half a dozen separate applications for mail, documents, tasks, time tracking, and analytics; the fork consolidates them into a single deeply integrated browser-based workspace.
mentions.audience: The author's own use as an all-in-one workspace; by extension power users and individual knowledge workers who want a single integrated browsing/working environment
mentions.author: ramijames
